_README: Ground truth for the crypto-scanner benchmark. A labelled finding is an ACTIVE call site of a quantum-vulnerable primitive. Algorithm names appearing only in comments, docstrings or string literals are deliberately NOT labelled: they are the hard-negative component of the benchmark. Labels are (line, algorithm) pairs; a prediction counts as a true positive only on an exact match of both.

_labelling_policy.import_statements: labelled - an import of a vulnerable primitive is part of the migration surface
_labelling_policy.function_definitions_naming_a_primitive: labelled when the body implements it (e.g. diffie_hellman_exchange)
